# ROADMAP: the engine line names its recurring read, pair and triggers

## Context

[D#19394](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19394) (the META loop: a recurring health read per release line) reached its §6.2 quorum on 2026-10-04 (Sophie [18743736](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19394#discussioncomment-18743736), the non-author family; Grace 18743769; Vega 18744013). Its graduation artifact (ii) is *one paragraph in each release line's `ROADMAP.md` "How it runs" — the recurring read, its pair, its triggers, the transport precondition, and that a finding changes the owning record — Institution first.* The Institution half is neomjs/neo-agent-institution#667, merged 2026-10-10 (PR #668). This ticket is the engine half. The first recurring synthesis ([18854592](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19394#discussioncomment-18854592)) found the paragraph missing on every line.

## Build order (the operator, 2026-10-10 21:5xZ)

**Parked until the v13.2 release.** The engine `ROADMAP.md` is fully rewritten after the release (the `update-roadmap` beat: celebrate the shipped line, plan the next as cornerstones + rationale + a deferred set); the release is close — the film (#15252, Emmy and Mnemosyne) is the last piece. A paragraph added now would be rewritten within days. So this ticket carries the **requirement** into that rewrite: whoever authors the post-release ROADMAP includes the paragraph below as part of the rewrite, and this ticket closes with that PR. No PR of its own before the rewrite. The assignee keeps the requirement, not a builder's lane.

## The Problem

`ROADMAP.md` tells a reader how the 13.2 release is ordered (the **How it runs.** paragraph of `## Next: Engine 13.2`, line 41: the consumption chain, the cadence, "any peer claims subs; the steward owns the outcome") and, since #19330, that the Institution line has its own roadmap and gate. It does not say who re-reads the engine line as a whole, when, with whom, what must be true before such a read is scheduled, or where a finding lands — the loop D#19394 graduated. The two receipts of what an un-named read costs are on the Discussion: the 10-04 idle-out and the State line that read "quorum owed" for six days after the quorum arrived.

## The Architectural Reality

- `ROADMAP.md` on `dev` (699bcb9b94+): the file-level line table (#19330, 2026-09-30) names the three release lines; `## Next: Engine 13.2` carries the cornerstones and its own **How it runs.** paragraph (release ordering), which becomes shipped history at the cut (`update-roadmap` rewrites `## Next`). The paragraph this ticket adds is **line-level**, release-independent, and therefore belongs beside the line table, not inside the next release's section — it must survive every cut unchanged. **The post-release rewrite is the moment to place it** (Build order above).
- The vocabulary is fixed by D#19394 and shared with the Institution paragraph (#667, merged): three responsibilities each held by a pair (self-selected steward + independent reader of another family); the loop *observe → decide against current authority → give the next action a holder → verify its effect → revisit or retire*; the transport precondition (*sent · mailbox-readable · route-active · delivered*; detect neomjs/neo-agent-brain#503, delivery neomjs/neo-agent-brain#30); the acceptance tuple; triggers = every release cut, every change to user obligations, layout or canonical ownership, plus a recurring synthesis (the week is the fallback).
- The engine line's debt home is D#19394's OQ3 — **open** for `neo` (Institution has #42 / #24, the Brain the #212 family). The paragraph names that the home is open; it does not invent one.
- The ungraduated carriers (`Health:` lines, a `Debt accepted:` PR line, `CODEOWNERS`, Golden Path wiring, measurement code) stay out of this file.

## The Fix

As part of the post-release ROADMAP rewrite, add **one paragraph** at the file level, directly after the line table and before the next `## Next` section, in the file's voice (prose, no table, no dates): (1) the line is re-read as a whole — milestone and epics, the release notes' claims, the debt map once it has a home, the transport axis — at every release cut, at every change to user obligations, layout or canonical ownership, and otherwise weekly, as the recurring synthesis of D#19394; (2) the pair — a self-selected holder (for the v1 window Clio, named on the Discussion) and an independent reader of another family; acceptance, never presence or an old assignment, establishes the next reader; explicit handoff; an unfilled seat names the action that fills it; (3) the transport precondition with its four observations and the two Brain homes; (4) a finding lands in the owning epic or ADR with its acceptance tuple, never as a new tracker by default — and that the engine line's debt home is an open question the first synthesis to need it must answer; (5) the carriers stay out until a failed transition names one and its consumer. Link D#19394 and 18854592. The Institution paragraph (neomjs/neo-agent-institution `ROADMAP.md`, **How the line is re-read.**) is the shape to mirror.

**Design authority:** none challenged. **Decision Record impact:** none (D#19394: `Decision Record: NOT_NEEDED`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 — The post-release `ROADMAP.md` carries one file-level paragraph, after the line table and before `## Next`, with each of the five elements in its own sentence: the read and its triggers; the pair and the handoff rule; the transport precondition (four observations, Brain #503 / #30); where a finding lands (owning epic or ADR, the acceptance tuple) and that the engine line's debt home is still open; what stays out.
- [ ] AC-2 — It links D#19394 and 18854592; it names no date and no number that would stale.
- [ ] AC-3 — The paragraph adds no table, file, counter, label or workflow.
- [ ] AC-4 — The cross-family reviewer of the rewrite's PR answers from the paragraph alone, as a stranger: who re-reads the engine line, when, with whom, what must be true first, where a finding goes — recorded in the review.
- [ ] AC-5 *(post-merge)* — D#19394's body line for artifact (ii) records both halves (#667 merged; this ticket's PR) with their links.

## Out of Scope

The Institution half (#667, done). The Brain (no release-line `ROADMAP.md`; its plan is neomjs/neo-agent-brain#212, artifact (i)). Choosing the engine line's debt home (OQ3 — the first synthesis that needs it decides, on D#19394). Any carrier. The 13.2 cut itself and the content of the post-release rewrite beyond this paragraph.

## Avoided Traps

- **A PR before the rewrite** — it would land inside a file about to be rewritten (the operator, 2026-10-10); the paragraph rides the rewrite instead.
- **Placing the paragraph inside `## Next`** — it would turn into shipped history at the next cut; the read outlives any release.
- **A `Health:` line with numbers** — stales, cannot retire a gap record (D#19394 option A, unbundled).
- **A dated cadence** — triggers are events; the week is the fallback.
- **Inventing the engine's debt home here** — OQ3 is open on the Discussion; a paragraph does not decide it.
